intro: Freshly cooked lunch favourites, paninis, jacket potatoes, desserts and bar pizzas — all served with The Alma’s proper local welcome.
service_note: Lunch is served Monday to Friday, 12pm–2:30pm. Food is cooked fresh to order in the 5-star rated kitchen, so please allow around 20–25 minutes at busy times.
highlights: Freshly cooked pub favourites from the 5-star rated kitchen
Paninis, jacket potatoes, dirty chips and desserts
Pizzas available at the bar when you fancy something to eat
Function food options available for suitable private bookings

public_house_notes.text: Please help keep the garden tidy, use the ashtrays provided, respect our neighbours, and enjoy the space calmly.
